prose.subject: Invoice INV-24553 - Rowan Analytics
prose.body:
Hello,

Please find attached invoice INV-24553 for services rendered to Eastgate Clinics during the current billing period. The total amount due is 9194.99 USDC. Payment is due within 30 days of receipt. This invoice covers our standard monthly analytics package, including data processing, report generation, and technical support as per our service agreement.

Line Items:
1. Core Data Analysis Services: 6500.00 USDC
2. Monthly Report Generation: 1800.00 USDC
3. Priority Technical Support: 894.99 USDC
Total: 9194.99 USDC

Please remit payment to our designated testnet account: rowananalytics62.testnet. Kindly reference invoice number INV-24553 in your payment details to ensure proper reconciliation. If you have any questions or require a revised breakdown, please contact our billing team at billing@rowan-analytics.example. We appreciate your continued partnership with Rowan Analytics.

Best regards,
Mara Quinn
Accounts Receivable
Rowan Analytics
